title: AC1024 associative parallel-constraint node
scope: Decode the witnessed AC1024 version-0 AcParallelConstraint body without consuming a node handle, while preserving the remaining unsupported graph and strict export refusal.

independentReader.outputIndexNote: The peer's node[0] is an empty in-memory sentinel; node[39] is the fortieth vector entry and the thirty-ninth serialized node.

sourceProfile.peerDecodedNode: Parallel { owner_id: 0, is_implied: false, is_active: true, datum_line_index: None }
sourceProfile.peerWireInterpretation: The peer calls read_geometrical_constraint(reader, legacy). For this source version-0 group, legacy makes active=true a synthesized model value; no active bit is read. The AcParallelConstraint branch does not read datum_line_index or a class-specific handle. Horizontal and Vertical nodes use a different conditional index path and are not included here.
wireLayout: Active: absent on the version-0 wire; the peer's true is normalized state.

localTrace.result: The real source decodes node ID 408, owner 0, implied false, activePresent false; body position advances from bit 6353 to 6356 while the handle position remains bit 218420.
localTrace.otherInstance: The same group also decodes node ID 247 with the same body profile and unchanged handle position.

sections: Bit Codes and Data Definitions, page 7: B and BL are bit-level values.
Handle References, page 16: typed handle role meanings; this class body contains no handle field.
odaSpecification.result: ODA defines the generic primitive encodings and handle roles; the peer source and same-input trace identify this class body.

limitations: The independent reader is structural evidence only and does not qualify consumer semantics or promote a support claim.
The implementation is limited to this version-0 inline profile; other constraint classes and registry layouts remain separate.
AcDistanceConstraint node 77 is the next unsupported body; the real group remains partial and strict export refusal is required.
Full associative closure, DXF serialization, readback and consumer meaning remain unqualified.

implementation.change: Added AcParallelConstraint to the already-verified version-0 geometrical-body path. It reuses the owner-ID/implied decoder and keeps the active flag explicitly absent.
implementation.generatedControl: A from-scratch Parallel node is followed by a non-null code-4 AcConstrainedImplicitPoint. Exact decoded point fields, the one-handle decoded count, complete node body and following sentinel prove Parallel consumes no handle and leaves the next dependency aligned.
implementation.strictExport: dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized remains active; no DXF output is created.

realSourceNormal.result: Trace decodes both observed Parallel nodes and advances from 39 to 49 node envelopes, stopping at AcDistanceConstraint node 77. Expected strict export refusal; no DXF was created.

realSourceAsan.result: Same Parallel decoding and next-node boundary; no AddressSanitizer diagnostic and no DXF output.

nextAction: Implement source-matched AcDistanceConstraint node 77; probe its two handle roles/references and conditional direction/distance body fields before consuming them.
